title: 砸鸡蛋
description: 本 Mod 改变了游戏中鸡蛋的投掷效果：扔出去的鸡蛋砸中任何东西后，不再只是随机出小鸡，而是会触发各种随机事件——掉落随机物品、生成随机生物、甚至爆炸。你的鸡越多，鸡蛋越多，惊喜（和惊吓）也越多。This mod changes the throwing effect of eggs in the game: when the eggs are thrown and hit anything
body:
# 使用AI制作，本人不懂任何代码有bug勿喷 

本 Mod 改变了游戏中鸡蛋的投掷效果：扔出去的鸡蛋砸中任何东西后，不再只是随机出小鸡，而是会触发各种随机事件——掉落随机物品、生成随机生物、甚至爆炸。你的鸡越多，鸡蛋越多，惊喜（和惊吓）也越多。

概率	事件	详细效果：

30%	无事发生	鸡蛋破碎，没有任何后续效果

15%	出小鸡 + 掉落物品	生成 1-4 只幼年小鸡，同时额外掉落随机物品。小鸡越多，掉落的物品数量也越多（1只→1个，2只→4个，3只→16个，4只→64个）

45%	掉落随机物品	掉落 1 个随机物品。

8%	生成随机生物（不会生成玩家、画、物品展示框、TNT 等非生物实体）

2%	爆炸特效	随机触发以下三种之一：点燃的 TNT、小火球、或者一片随机药水效果的滞留云（持续 10 秒）

本 Mod 没有添加任何合成配方，所有功能仅通过正常获取原版鸡蛋、投掷鸡蛋即可触发。
如果你安装了其他 Mod，它们的物品和生物也会进入随机池


# Created using AI; I don’t know any code, so please don’t blame me for any bugs. 

This mod changes the throwing mechanics of eggs in the game: when an egg hits something, it no longer just randomly spawns a chick—it triggers various random events, such as dropping random items, spawning random mobs, or even exploding. The more chickens and eggs you have, the more surprises (and scares) you’ll encounter.

Probability    Event    Detailed Effect:

30%    Nothing happens    The egg shatters with no further effects

15%    Chicks + Item Drop    Generates 1–4 baby chicks and drops a random item. The more chicks, the more items dropped (1 chick → 1 item, 2 chicks → 4 items, 3 chicks → 16 items, 4 chicks → 64 items)

45%    Drop Random Item    Drops 1 random item.

8%    Spawn Random Mob (Will not spawn non-mob entities such as players, paintings, item display frames, TNT, etc.)

2%    Explosion Effect    Randomly triggers one of the following three: ignited TNT, a small fireball, or a lingering cloud with a random potion effect (lasts 10 seconds)

This mod does not add any crafting recipes; all features are triggered solely by obtaining vanilla eggs and throwing them.
If you have other mods installed, their items and mobs will also be included in the random pool.
